title: Refund Checks from School Nutrition Services Meal Accounts, Including Active Accounts at CEP Campuses
content:
## Rule

Reimbursable breakfasts and lunches are served at no charge at a campus operating the Community Eligibility Provision (Cypress Hollow Elementary, Pecan Grove Elementary and Hollis Middle School), so a household may ask School Nutrition to refund the balance on an active School Nutrition Services Meal Account at such a campus.

A positive balance is refunded by district check on an inactive account after the student withdraws or graduates, on the household's request, when the balance is at least the refund minimum, and, for an active account at a CEP campus and only for such an account, on the household's request when the CEP refund amount is at least the refund minimum; no other active account is refunded, and every refund check is mailed within the refund processing period in calendar days.

A refund from an inactive account always pays out the entire positive balance; a refund from an active account at a CEP campus pays out the CEP refund amount and leaves the rest of the balance on the account.

A CEP refund is not paid until every departure rollover owed from the inactive account of a sibling who left for another state or country has been made. A CEP refund is not paid until the household has made the repayment-plan payment due today on every other active account of the household whose unpaid meal charges are at least the online deposit minimum. A CEP refund is not paid until every rollover owed from a graduate's inactive account in the household has been made.

## Which accounts are refunded

| Account | Refunded on the household's request | What is paid out |
|---|---|---|
| inactive, after withdrawal or graduation, balance at least the refund minimum | yes | the entire positive balance |
| active, at a CEP campus, CEP refund amount at least the refund minimum | yes | the CEP refund amount; the rest stays on the account |
| active, at any other campus | no | nothing |

## Paying the refund: `refund_cep_meal_balance_19cb6a0f`

**Capability.** School Nutrition refunds, by district check mailed to the household, part or all of the balance on a student's active cafeteria meal account at a campus that serves reimbursable meals at no charge, on the household's request. One call posts one refund: the amount leaves the account balance as a refund dated today with the reason household request, and the rest of the balance stays on the account; the household receives the check by mail.

**How it is invoked.** The agent unlocks `refund_cep_meal_balance_19cb6a0f` (through `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`).

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `meal_account_id` | the meal account reference number of the student whose balance is refunded, as returned by the meal account lookup for the household | identifier, exactly as returned |
| `amount` | the refund paid by check | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents), already rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A confirmation sentence carrying four fields: the refund record reference (text identifier of the new account transaction), the meal account reference refunded, the refund amount in US dollars with two decimals and the refund date (YYYY-MM-DD). The presence of the refund record reference means the refund posted. A message beginning with "Error:" means nothing was posted: "Error: amount must be a positive dollar amount with at most two decimal places." for an amount that is not positive or has more than two decimals, and an error naming the reference when no meal account carries it.
